bio.text: Jim Woodward is a Republican who represents District 1 in the Idaho Senate; the legislature's directory lists Woodward as in a first term, after two earlier Senate terms from 2018 to 2022.
According to the legislature's biography, Woodward was raised in Bonners Ferry and Sandpoint and holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the University of Idaho.
It lists 21 years of active and reserve service as a U.S. Navy submarine officer, and says Woodward owns and operates a heavy construction company.
